description.html: A 35x25 cm floor, 30 cm of height, about 26.3 liters. It differs from the 35x25x28 model in its 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam and in two extra centimeters of height. The background takes up part of the depth, but provides a wall for the animal to climb. Ventilation is handled by mesh vents, and the front glass panels slide.

A young crested gecko uses that background as its main surface for moving around, together with a branch and a plant. Leopard and fat-tailed geckos stay on the floor, and the ledges of the background near the bottom serve them as extra cover. A juvenile corn snake climbs the relief, so check that the sliding glass is always closed all the way.

The next size up with similar proportions is the 40x25x30, and the wider one is the 35x30x25. If you want the background to continue onto one side wall as well, we do that by agreement. The build time is 7 to 14 days. The outside gets a film in the pattern you choose, and we ship the terrarium by courier.
